title: Capacity carousel + snackbars: progressive onboarding visuals for Dedicated
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a set of onboarding visuals focused on a compact capacity carousel + transient snackbars to introduce Dedicated capacity setup, autoscale previews, and SLA tradeoffs. The assets should be usable inside the Console first-run flow, the Quickstart doc, and a short in-product guided tour. We want lightweight illustrations that animate between three capacity states (development, production, burst) and snackbars that reveal cost/SLA hints inline when users toggle autoscale or change instance counts. Deliverables: Figma files with frames for LTR/RTL, 3 animation keyframes (collapsed, expanded, autoscale-preview), microcopy variants for snackbars, accessible color tokens, and export-ready PNG/SVGs for docs.
acceptance_criteria: Three carousel frames created: Dev (low cost), Prod (balanced), Burst (high throughput)

Snackbars with 3 microcopy tones: informational, caution, success — each with CTA pattern
(learn more / adjust autoscale)
SVG exports for each illustration and a 12-frame Lottie-esque animation sequence exported as high-framerate PNGs for docs demo
Figma prototype with click-to-advance carousel and autoscale toggle that updates the SLA badge and cost estimator mock
Design tokens documented (colors, spacing, typography) and a short accessibility note about motion / reduced-motion fallback
design_refs: Inspiration: GCP instance-picker carousel, small-business onboarding patterns
